senses.gloss: धम a. (f. मा or मी) (generally at the end of a compound) 1. Blowing (as fire, trumpet &c.); 2. melting, fusing.
धम (II) m. 1. The moon; 2. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa; 3. of Yama, the god of death.
धम a. (f. मा or मी) (generally at the end of a compound) 1. Blowing (as fire, trumpet &c.); 2. melting, fusing.
धम a. (f. मा or मी) (generally at the end of a compound) 1. Blowing (as fire, trumpet &c.); 2. melting, fusing.
धमि f. The act of blowing.
धमक m. A blacksmith.
धामक m. A sort of weight, (the same as माष q.v.).
धमधमा ind. An imitative word expressive of the sound made by blowing with a bellows or a trumpet.
धमन a. (f. ना) 1. Blowing; 2. cruel.
धमन a. (f. ना) 1. Blowing; 2. cruel.
धमनि f. 1. A reed, a pipe; 2. a tube or canal of the human body (i.e. a vein, a nerve &c.); 3. throat, neck.
धमनि f. 1. A reed, a pipe; 2. a tube or canal of the human body (i.e. a vein, a nerve &c.); 3. throat, neck.
धामनिका f. The same as धमनी q.v.
धम्मल m. The braided and ornamented hair of a woman, intermixed with flowers, pearls &c., उरसि निपतितानां स्रस्तधम्मिलकानां (वधूनाम्) Bhartr.i.49.

धामन् n. 1. A dwelling place, a house, a residence, त्यजति ललितधाम Git.G.v., पुण्यं यायास्त्रिभुवनगुरोर्धाम चंडीश्वरस्य Megh.i.13, Bg.viii.21; 2. the inmates of a house, the members of a family; 3. a place, a site, an abode; 4. light, lustre, splendour, Am.S. 86; 5. a ray of light (as in हिमधामन्), Sis.ix.53; 6. majesty, glory, R.xi.85, 7. birth; 8. the body; 9. power, strength, energy, Kir.ii.47.
धामन्-केशिन्, -निधि m. an epithet of the sun.

धामनिका f. The same as धमनी q.v.
